translations.web: But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.
translations.bsb: Yet they would not listen or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and would not listen or receive My discipline.
translations.kjv: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
translations.asv: But they hearkened not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.
